description: This file defines the TagsExtractor interface, which specifies methods for extracting and managing quick-text tags within the application.

classes.name: TagsExtractor
classes.description: An interface for extracting quick-text outputs based on tags, checking if the extractor is enabled, and releasing resources.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether this extractor is enabled and functional.

methods.name: getOutputForTag
methods.description: Returns a list of quick-text outputs related to the specified tag.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases all resources associated with this extractor instance.
